title: Fixture Supplier v Buyer (3d Cir.) [TEST]
facts: A B2B supply contract had a Delaware forum-selection clause. The district court refused to enforce it. The supplier appeals.
grounds_of_appeal: Forum-selection clauses in B2B contracts are presumptively enforceable.
The buyer did not show the exceptional circumstances that defeat enforcement.

grounds: The clause is mandatory and selects Delaware courts.
There is no fraud or overreaching on this record.
Enforcement would be unreasonable on these facts.
Public-policy interests of the forum weigh against transfer.

issues: Whether the Delaware forum-selection clause is enforceable.
press_questions: Counsel, what exceptional circumstance defeats this clause?
reason_paragraphs: 1. Forum-selection clauses in B2B contracts are presumptively enforceable.
2. The record does not show the exceptional case that defeats enforcement.
bench_notes.real_holding: Judgment reversed. The forum-selection clause is enforced.

real_holding: Judgment reversed. The forum-selection clause is enforced.
